title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-Margined GPSUSDT and SHELLUSDT Perpetual Contracts With up to 25x Leverage
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To expand the list of trading choices offered on Binance Futures and enhance users’ trading experience, Binance Futures will launch the following perpetual contracts with up to 25x leverage as below: 2025-02-17 17:00 (UTC):  GPSUSDT  Perpetual Contract 2025-02-17 17:15 (UTC):  SHELLUSDT  Perpetual Contract *Please note that  GoPlus Security  ( LINK )  and  MyShell ( LINK )  are already listed on Binance Alpha Market. More details on the aforementioned perpetual contracts can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract GPSUSDT SHELLUSDT Launch Time 2025-02-17 17:00 (UTC) 2025-02-17 17:15 (UTC) Underlying Asset GoPlus Security (GPS)  MyShell (SHELL) Contract Address 0x0c1dc73159e30c4b06170f2593d3118968a0dca5 0xf2c88757f8d03634671208935974B60a2a28Bdb3 Project Info GoPlus Security is building Web3's first decentralized security layer, providing comprehensive protection across all blockchain networks. MyShell is building an AI consumer layer that connects users, creators, and open-source AI researchers. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the aforementioned GPSUSDT and SHELLUSDT perpetual contracts across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the aforementioned perpetual contracts.  The aforementioned perpetual contracts are subject to the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement . Futures and spot token listings are not correlated. A token listed on Binance Futures  does not guarantee  that it will be listed on Binance Spot.
